Poznaj historię marki Rotenso: Discover the story of the Rotenso brand
Na Śląsku rozpoczyna działalność Thermos: Thermosilesia starts operating in Silesia — a company installing, servicing and selling RAC and CAC air conditioning systems of leading manufacturers. It is the foundation on which Rotenso will be built 14 years later.
Firma dysponuje zaledwie 150 m² powierzc: The company has just 150 m² of warehouse space and 80 pallet places — the starting point for today's logistics centre of more than 20,000 m².
Thermosilesia rozpoczyna program produkc: Thermosilesia starts a programme to produce, develop and promote its own HVAC brands — a strategic decision that four years later leads to the creation of Rotenso.
Pierwszą marką własną wprowadzoną na ryn: The first own brand on the market is Ferono fans and air curtains — a test of the model that will soon be repeated with Rotenso.
Na polskim rynku debiutują klimatyzatory: Rotenso air conditioners debut on the Polish market as Thermosilesia's flagship brand. From then on the company invests in inverter technology, the design of wall, cassette and commercial units, and building an installer network.
Kolejno powstają: Tivento (rury miedzian: One after another come Tivento (insulated copper pipes), Swedo (condensate pumps), Ivensis (installation accessories) and Cleanairix (professional service chemicals). By 2018 the Thermosilesia team has 47 people.
Po przeprowadzce do Rudy Śląskiej powier: After moving to Ruda Śląska, Thermosilesia's logistics centre grows to 4,300 m² and its pallet places to 6,700. Rotenso gains real capacity to scale its sales.
Od klimatyzacji do pełnego HVAC: From air conditioning to full HVAC
Oferta Rotenso wykracza poza klimatyzato: Rotenso's range goes beyond wall-mounted air conditioners: air-to-water heat pumps (Aquami, Airmi, Windmi, Heatmi), extended commercial systems and VRF/RVF units arrive. The units run on the eco-friendly R32 refrigerant.
Rotenso rozbudowuje sieć autoryzowanych: Rotenso expands its network of authorised installers and service in Poland and Europe, broadens its range of wall-mounted air conditioners (including the Versu, Mirai, Elis, Ukura and Imoto series) and runs regular technical training for the installation industry.
Na targach MCE w Mediolanie Rotenso prez: At MCE in Milan Rotenso presents a brand-new line of Wentilo ICON heat recovery units. Thermosilesia celebrates 24 years in business, the team numbers 188 people and the company receives a Forbes Diamond for its rapid growth.
Warsaw HVAC Expo i nowe centrum: Warsaw HVAC Expo and a new centre
Rotenso prezentuje nowości na Warsaw HVA: Rotenso presents its new products at Warsaw HVAC Expo. In Ruda Śląska construction begins on one of the largest investments in the company's history — a new logistics centre of more than 17,000 m².
Centrum logistyczne osiąga ponad 20 000: The logistics centre reaches more than 20,000 m² and 29,000 pallet places. Rotenso launches a new RVF systems catalogue for the 2026/27 season and further air conditioner series (including Luve, Teta, Roni and Fresh), and is present in Poland, Germany, France, Czechia, Italy and Ukraine.
Nasze produkty spełniają najwyższe europ: Our products meet the highest European standards of quality, safety and energy efficiency. Every unit goes through rigorous tests before it goes on sale.
